title: Minimum Operations To Make All Array Elements Equal
statement:
For each value in `queries`, compute the minimum number of increment or decrement operations needed to make every element of `nums` equal to that value. Return the results in the same order as `queries`.

## Examples

```text
Input: nums = [3, 1, 6, 8], queries = [1, 5]
Output: [14, 10]
```

```text
Input: nums = [2, 9, 6, 3], queries = [10]
Output: [20]
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= nums.length, queries.length <= 10^5`
- `1 <= nums[i], queries[i] <= 10^9`
